question: How is the kula kuṇḍalinī visualized in terms of extent and nature?
premises: The kula kuṇḍalinī is the object of contemplation.
It extends from the mūlādhāra to the tip of the tongue.
It is described as having the nature of consciousness.
inference: The kula kuṇḍalinī should be contemplated as consciousness extending from the mūlādhāra to the tongue.
plain_english: One should contemplate the kula kuṇḍalinī, whose nature is consciousness, extending from the mūlādhāra up to the tip of the tongue.
